ai_summary: This disclosure reveals that Sandeep Gupta and his Persons Acting in Concert, who are part of the Promoter Group of Asian Hotels (West) Limited, have increased their stake in the company by acquiring an additional 8.16% through an inter-se transfer. This acquisition boosts their collective holding from 11.58% to 19.74% of the total voting capital, signifying a consolidation of ownership within a specific segment of the existing promoter group without impacting the total share capital. A notable red flag is the stated 'Date of acquisition' as September 9, 2026, which is a future date and highly unusual for such a regulatory filing, suggesting a potential typo or disclosure of a planned future transaction.
